english.title: Registration plate applicant fail to notify of application changes
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person applying to be entered in the register of registration plate suppliers, maintained by the Secretary of State, failed to notify him or her of changes affecting in a material particular the accuracy of the information which you provided in connection with your application
english.legislation: Contrary to section 27(1) and (4) of the Vehicles (Crime) Act 2001.

english.notes:
(i) Proceedings under this Section instituted by a person or body other than a local authority or a constable must have the permission of the Attorney General.
(ii) See section 17(2) for clarification of "carries on business as a registration plate supplier".
(iii) "Registered" means registered in accordance with the provisions of Part 2 of the Vehicles (Crime) Act 2001 in a register established and maintained by the Secretary of State.
(iv) See section 31(1) for other interpretations of Part 2 of the Act.
(v) See section 27(5) for defence.
(vi) See section 20(2) for alternative/additional penalty.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

NOTE:
Where a registered person is convicted of this offence the court may, instead of or in addition to imposing a fine, by order suspend his registration for any period of up to five years. (section 20(2)).

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
